manual.ronova.basics.title: Basics
manual.ronova.basics.body:
Ronova is the Ruler of Death. Anything mortal dies to her power instantly, no matter its armor. Only creative-mode players and spectators are safe.

§6R§r — use the selected skill.
§6X§r — tap: next skill. Hold: the skill wheel — point at a skill and release X. In the wheel, drag a skill with the mouse to swap places.
§6X§r + §61–8§r — use the skill in that place of the wheel right away (or only select it — see «For me» in the settings).
§6X§r + §6mouse wheel§r — flip through skills without opening the wheel (in the Realm — exit worlds).
§6Tab§r — aim assist: hold it, or tap once and it keeps aiming (see «For me» in the settings).
§6LMB§r and §6RMB§r get special actions with Authority, in the Realm, with the Unsleeping Eyes and with Mortification (RMB — Doppelganger) — hints appear next to the crosshair.

The selected skill and its cooldown are shown on the panel right of the hotbar. Keys can be changed in the controls settings.

Settings: §6/ronova config§r or Mods → Ronova → Settings (on Fabric — through Mod Menu). Operators can change everything; any player can set «For me»: their own look for others, aim assist and what X + digit does.

Become Ronova with §6/ronova grant§r. Usually there is one Ronova per world; several at once can be allowed in the settings.
manual.ronova.beam.title: Crimson Beam
manual.ronova.beam.body:
Hold §6R§r — a crimson charge starts gathering in her palm.

§cQuick beam§r — let go of R before it's fully charged: a short, thin shot.
§cFull beam§r — keep holding and it fires on its own after a second and a half. At the end of its path it explodes — a 10-block radius.

The beam reaches 500 blocks or the first wall; it doesn't break blocks. Arrows and other projectiles in its way burn up.

When the beam rushes past you, you hear it whistle.
manual.ronova.sniper.title: Sniper Flash
manual.ronova.sniper.body:
The moment she fires, a bright star-shaped glint flashes at Ronova's hand. Only those she's aiming at can see it — not from the side, not from behind.

From far away the glint doesn't shrink, it turns white, like the gleam of a sniper scope — you can see it even beyond your render distance. If something gleams in the distance, the beam is already on its way to you.
manual.ronova.aim.title: Aim Assist
manual.ronova.aim.body:
Hold §6Tab§r while the beam or the orb is selected, or while the Unsleeping Eyes are out. In «For me» in the settings it can be switched to a tap: press once and it keeps aiming; press again, switch the skill or let the target die — and it lets go.

It locks onto the creature closest to the center of your screen, up to 500 blocks away. A seal appears on the target and an eye next to it: that's where to shoot to hit it while it moves. Your view turns to it by itself; distance and flight time are shown under the seal.

Next to the crosshair is the target card: its name and health with a heart («now / max»). If the target holds a §ctotem of undying§r or is §cinvulnerable§r, the card shows it.

If the target hides completely behind blocks, §cthe eye closes§r — then your shot simply goes where you're looking.

With the Unsleeping Eyes, every feather flies at the locked target.
manual.ronova.orb.title: Crimson Orb
manual.ronova.orb.body:
Press §6R§r — an orb flies where you're looking, up to 500 blocks. Hold R to fire one after another.

It bursts when it touches a block or a creature — a 3.5-block radius. Blocks stay intact; projectiles nearby burn up.

With aim assist the orb leads its target on its own.
manual.ronova.shield.title: Crimson Shield
manual.ronova.shield.body:
Hold §6R§r — a shield rises in front of Ronova.

It has 250 HP and only covers the front: hits from the side or behind, falls and fire get through. Arrows and other projectiles burn up against it, and anyone who comes too close is pushed away. While lowered, it quickly recovers.

The ring around your crosshair shows its HP.

If the shield gets §cshattered§r, you can raise it again only after 30 seconds.
manual.ronova.authority.title: Authority of Death
manual.ronova.authority.body:
Press §6R§r — a rift with a huge eye tears open behind Ronova. Everyone nearby sees it fill their screen.

While the rift is open:
§6LMB§r — "Death": the death wave.
§6RMB§r — "Realm": step through the eye into Ronova's Realm.

The rift stays open while you stay close to it; walk away and it closes after a few seconds. Press §6R§r again to close it yourself. The eye can be destroyed by dealing 500 damage to it, and then the rift closes.
manual.ronova.death.title: Death Wave
manual.ronova.death.body:
With the rift open, hold §6LMB§r — the wave gathers strength: the longer you hold, the farther it reaches, up to 500 blocks in 6 seconds. Release — and it spreads from you in every direction.

Every living thing it reaches §cfreezes§r: the captured glow red and cannot escape, however long you hold them. Projectiles freeze in mid-air too.

§6LMB§r again — «Death»: the captured crumble to ash, and nature where the wave passed yellows and dies (see «Death of nature»).
§6RMB§r — release everyone (at the rift too; to dive into the Realm, press RMB once more).

Mobs killed by the wave drop no loot or experience, and nothing spawns where the wave passed for 5 minutes.
manual.ronova.realm.title: Ronova's Realm
manual.ronova.realm.body:
With the rift open, press §6RMB§r — the eye pulls Ronova into her Realm, a crimson void. You end up at the same spot as in the world.

Here you can't die, you can fly, and health and hunger restore on their own. Keep flying in one direction and Ronova §cspeeds up§r — to 3.5× in 6 seconds.

From here Ronova §csees the souls§r of every player in the world the Realm reflects — wherever they are, with no distance limit.

§6RMB§r — leave: a rift opens in the world and you step out of it.
§6LMB§r — hold to peek: Ronova's eye opens in the world at the same spot, and you look through it. The eye can be spotted and destroyed. Let go — the eye closes and you come back.
§6X§r — choose another world: the Nether, the End, the Afterlife and worlds from other mods.

While peeking, §6R§r opens a rift right there, and you can leave through it.
manual.ronova.escape.title: Escape to the Realm
manual.ronova.escape.body:
If a hit would kill Ronova, a portal pulls her into the Realm at the last moment. It even saves her from falling into the void.

After an escape it takes §c60 seconds§r before it can work again — the countdown is shown next to the skill panel. Until then, a deadly hit really kills. In the Realm itself she can't die.

After an escape, you'll leave the Realm through the same portal.
manual.ronova.jump.title: Crow Step
manual.ronova.jump.body:
Hold §6R§r — a mark appears where you're looking, up to 128 blocks away.

Release — Ronova scatters into a flock of crows and reforms at the mark. You take no fall damage after the step. If there's no room at the mark, nothing happens.
manual.ronova.feathers.title: The Unsleeping Eyes
manual.ronova.feathers.body:
Press §6R§r — the Unsleeping Eyes open behind Ronova's back. Press again to close them.

§6LMB§r — "Volley": feathers fly from the eyes, one at every target in front of you (up to 128 blocks). The feathers find their targets on their own and fly around obstacles.

§6RMB§r — "Crow Circle": a strike around Ronova, see its own page.

With aim assist, every feather flies at one target.

While the Eyes are open, LMB doesn't attack or break blocks.
manual.ronova.rain.title: Rain of Feathers
manual.ronova.rain.body: Hold §6R§r — feathers rain down from the sky where you look (up to 128 blocks), a nonstop scattered stream for as long as you hold it. Move your gaze and the rain follows. Each feather strikes the ground with a flash and a small blast, turns anyone near it to ash and stays stuck in a glowing crack for a while.
manual.ronova.mortify.title: Mortification
manual.ronova.mortify.body:
Press §6R§r — Ronova soars into the air, and the world for 80 blocks around fades into a crimson starry sphere. An eye opens behind her, star stones rise from the ground, beams strike the sky.

Everything mortal inside is §clocked in§r: nobody can leave the sphere — its wall throws them back.

A few seconds later the world §cshatters§r — the blast floods the screen and shards fly across it. Mobs inside die, and players go to the Afterlife, where they have to find their own way out. What happens to players can be changed in the settings: send to the Afterlife, kill or spare.

§6RMB§r with Mortification selected — the Doppelganger menu.

Cooldown: 60 seconds.
manual.ronova.doppel.title: Doppelganger
manual.ronova.doppel.body:
Select Mortification and press §6RMB§r — a list of the souls now in the Afterlife opens.

Pick a soul — Ronova takes its form: skin, arms and name above the head, in chat and in the player list. Her dress, wings and glow are hidden.

«Own look» — become Ronova again. If the soul escapes the Afterlife or leaves the game, the form falls away by itself.
manual.ronova.afterlife.title: Afterlife
manual.ronova.afterlife.body:
Players taken by Mortification end up here: floating ruins above the void, mist and silence. The only way back is through the §cgates of light§r — an arch with a mirror — which take you back to where you were taken from.

The gates are sealed. Only a §cguide§r can open them:
§c·§r a totem of undying in hand — it comes alive and leads to the nearest gates;
§c·§r or three §cshards of the Seal of Life§r from the altars — walk up to a bowl and a shard starts circling you. Three shards merge into the §cSeal of Life§r, and it leads to the gates.

Bring the guide to the mirror — it flies in, and the gates open only for you.

§cBond of Life§r — every hit Ronova lands on a soul here adds to the Bond (1 health per hit) and breaks its shards and seal. Health under the Bond does not heal, and the gates will not let you through until the Bond is cleared. Each new shard clears 1 health of the Bond, a totem of undying — 10. A soul in debt glows with a red flame along its outline — the bigger the Bond, the stronger the flame.

Chat here reaches only souls in the Afterlife within 100 blocks of you. The living in the normal world and souls farther away hear nothing.
manual.ronova.nature.title: Death of nature
manual.ronova.nature.body:
Ronova's attacks kill more than the living. Where a blow lands, nature §cyellows, browns and dies§r in a wave: leaves fall, grass dries out, sod turns to bare earth, flowers and bushes become dead bushes, crops, pumpkins and melons rot away and farmland dries up. Underwater, kelp and seagrass wither away, and corals bleach and die.

A yellowed band remains around the edge — plants there survive, but wilt.

Nature is killed by the full beam (blast and path), the orb blast, Mortification and the Death Wave — the wave only after §6LMB§r «Death».

What happens next is set in the settings: nothing, recolour only, regrows after a few minutes (from the edges inward) or forever. Each of these abilities has its own such setting, and it overrides the general one.
manual.ronova.circle.title: Crow Circle
manual.ronova.circle.body:
While the Unsleeping Eyes are open, press §6RMB§r. The Eyes flare, crimson ribbons spiral out from Ronova, crows sweep around the edge and a patterned wave runs across the ground. Every mortal within 8 blocks turns to ash in an instant.

If Ronova is off the ground, the strike becomes a sphere around her and reaches 8 blocks in every direction.

Cooldown: 4 seconds.
manual.ronova.passive.title: Passive Powers
manual.ronova.passive.body:
§cFlight§r — Ronova flies in survival too: double-tap jump.

§cProtective dome§r — hits under 8 damage fade away on their own. A hit of 8 damage or more breaks through the dome, and it takes 8 seconds to recover.

§cAsh§r — everything Ronova kills chars black, cracks and crumbles to ash.

§cA Totem of Undying§r won't save anyone from her: her eye opens in the totem, it cracks, and a couple of seconds later the victim crumbles to ash.

§cProjectiles§r burn up against her beam, orb, shield and dome, and ghast fireballs explode without hurting anyone.
manual.ronova.commands.title: Commands
manual.ronova.commands.body:
You need operator rights or cheats enabled (except for opening the settings).

§6/ronova grant [player]§r — make a player Ronova (no name — yourself). If there already is a Ronova, the power passes from her.
§6/ronova revoke [player]§r — take the power away.
§6/ronova who§r — see who is Ronova now.

There's a test bot to watch the skills from the outside:
§6/ronovabot spawn§r — call the bot, then §6/ronova grant RonovaBot§r.
§6/ronovabot look me§r — make it face you.
§6/ronovabot use <skill> [seconds]§r — use a skill (with seconds — hold it).
§6/ronovabot remove§r — remove the bot.

§6/ronova config§r — open the settings menu (for everyone; without operator rights — only «For me»).
§6/ronova config <setting> <value>§r — change a server setting (the same as the mod settings menu); §6/ronova config list§r — all of them in chat.
§6/ronova afterlife <player> release§r — bring a stuck soul back from the Afterlife.

ronova.config.title: Ronova — settings
ronova.config.file.header: Ronova: Ruler of Death — server settings.
ronova.config.file.how: The server (or the host of a single-player / LAN world) uses these and sends them to players.
ronova.config.file.edit: Change them here, in game with /ronova config <setting> <value>, or in Mods → Ronova → Config.
ronova.config.file.reset: Remove a line to return it to its default. After editing this file: /ronova config reload.
ronova.config.mode.local: File config/ronova.jsonc — for your single-player and LAN worlds
ronova.config.mode.host: This world: changes apply right away
ronova.config.mode.remote: Server settings: you are an operator, changes go to the server
ronova.config.mode.view: Set by the server — only operators can change them
ronova.config.client.self_look.desc: How you look when you are Ronova, for others and on your own screen. Only down from what the server allows — options above it are greyed out.
ronova.config.client.aim.desc: Hold — aims while the key is held. Tap — press once and it keeps aiming; press again, switch to a skill that cannot aim, or the target dies or goes too far — it lets go.
ronova.config.hint: Hover a setting to see what it does
ronova.config.number_hint: Drag the slider or click the value to type an exact number
ronova.config.client.keys.desc: Skill wheel, skill key and the rest are set in Minecraft’s Controls.
ronova.config.ability_off: This ability is turned off on this server
ronova.config.no_permission: Only operators can change Ronova settings
ronova.config.cmd.header: Ronova settings (%s) — click a section or a setting:
ronova.config.cmd.reset_all: All Ronova settings are back to defaults
ronova.config.category.abilities.desc: Turn single abilities on or off. A turned-off ability does nothing and says so.
ronova.config.general.abilities.desc: Off — Ronova keeps her look, but loses all abilities, passive protection and flight.
ronova.config.general.flight.desc: Ronova can fly in survival and adventure.
ronova.config.general.multiple.desc: On — /ronova grant adds another Ronova; every Ronova has all abilities. Off — there is only one: /ronova grant passes the power to the new one, and if several exist when this is turned off, the earliest keeps it.
ronova.config.general.music.desc: Music when the rift's eye opens and in the background of her Realm and the Afterlife. The track itself comes from a resource pack (not included in the mod).
ronova.config.general.look.desc: The most of her look the server allows: full — her skin, dress, pins and wings; wings — the player's own skin with her wings; own skin — nothing of her look. Each Ronova and each player can show less for themselves. Abilities stay either way.
ronova.config.general.nature_death.desc: What the beam (path and blast), the orb, the Death Wave and Mortification do to plants, unless the ability has its own setting. Off — nothing; visual only — plants yellow and wither, then turn green again, no blocks change; regrows — plants really die (leaves fall, grass dries, sod turns to bare earth) and grow back after a while; forever — they stay dead. Under the Death Wave plants die only on «Death» (LMB).
ronova.config.general.nature_regrow_seco: For «Regrows»: seconds from the hit until dead plants grow back, from the edges to the centre (180 = 3 minutes). A new hit on dead ground starts the count again.
ronova.config.client.look.desc: How you see Ronova on your screen, only on this computer. If the server shows less, its choice wins.
ronova.config.general.totem_bypass.desc: A Totem of Undying does not save from Ronova's abilities: she seizes it and the victim dies a few seconds later. Off — the totem saves as usual.
ronova.config.general.hit_animals.desc: Ronova's abilities hurt animals, villagers, pets, golems and other mobs that are not monsters.
ronova.config.abilities.beam.desc: Quick and full beam with a blast.
ronova.config.abilities.shield.desc: The shield she raises by hand.
ronova.config.abilities.death_wave.desc: The charged wave from the rift that freezes and kills.
ronova.config.abilities.rift_jump.desc: Scatter into crows and reform where she looks.
ronova.config.abilities.realm.desc: Entering and leaving her own dimension.
ronova.config.abilities.realm_peek.desc: Looking into a world through an eye from the Realm.
ronova.config.abilities.aim_assist.desc: Lock-on for the beam, the orb and the Feathers from the Eyes.
ronova.config.abilities.eye_feathers.des: Summoning and dismissing the feathers with eyes: while they are out, LMB shoots the Feathers from the Eyes and RMB strikes with the Crow Circle.
ronova.config.abilities.eye_spear.desc: Homing feathers shot from the eyes (LMB).
ronova.config.abilities.feather_rain.des: A stream of feathers onto where she looks.
ronova.config.abilities.crow_circle.desc: A strike around Ronova (RMB with the Eyes).
ronova.config.abilities.mortification.de: The crimson sphere that traps everyone inside; when it shatters, players go to the Afterlife and mobs die (see below).
ronova.config.abilities.doppelganger.des: Wearing the face, skin and name of any soul now in the Afterlife.
ronova.config.afterlife.debt_per_hit.des: Health points of Bond of Life each hit of Ronova puts on a soul in the Afterlife (at most once every half second).
Health points of Bond of Life a Totem of Undying clears when a soul holds it in the Afterlife (once per visit).
ronova.config.afterlife.chat_radius.desc: In the Afterlife, souls hear each other only within this many blocks. 0 — nobody hears. Ronova is heard everywhere.
ronova.config.afterlife.scares.desc: The watcher, the runner, footsteps, eerie sounds and «someone heard you».
ronova.config.passive.auto_shield.desc: Blocks weak hits by itself; a strong hit breaks it.
ronova.config.passive.escape.desc: A deadly hit pulls Ronova into her Realm instead of killing her.
ronova.config.passive.escape.enabled.des: A deadly hit pulls Ronova into her Realm instead of killing her; in the Realm she cannot die.
ronova.config.passive.escape.cooldown.de: Seconds after an escape when a deadly hit outside the Realm really kills.
ronova.config.abilities.beam.damage.desc: Damage of the attack in health points (2 = one heart, before armor); -1 — instant death, as by default. The beam and its blast.
ronova.config.abilities.beam.range.desc: How far the beam reaches, in blocks.
ronova.config.abilities.orb.damage.desc: Damage of the attack in health points (2 = one heart, before armor); -1 — instant death, as by default. The burst of an orb.
ronova.config.abilities.orb.range.desc: Blocks an orb flies before it bursts in the air.
ronova.config.abilities.shield.durabilit: How much damage the raised shield takes before it breaks.
ronova.config.abilities.shield.regen_per: Durability restored each second while the shield is down.
ronova.config.abilities.shield.broken_co: Seconds before a broken shield can be raised again.
ronova.config.abilities.death_wave.damag: Damage of the attack in health points (2 = one heart, before armor); -1 — instant death, as by default. Everyone frozen by the wave, on «Death» (LMB).
ronova.config.abilities.death_wave.coold: Seconds after a wave is released.
ronova.config.abilities.death_wave.max_r: Radius of a fully charged wave (6 s of charging), in blocks.
ronova.config.abilities.death_wave.dead_: Minutes no mobs spawn on their own within the wave's radius after it is released. 0 — off. −1 — forever.
How far she can jump, in blocks.
ronova.config.abilities.aim_assist.range: How far a target can be locked, in blocks (it is let go 40 blocks farther).
ronova.config.abilities.eye_spear.damage: Damage of the attack in health points (2 = one heart, before armor); -1 — instant death, as by default. Each feather that hits.
How far ahead of her the feathers look for targets, in blocks.
ronova.config.abilities.feather_rain.dam: Damage of the attack in health points (2 = one heart, before armor); -1 — instant death, as by default. Each falling feather.
ronova.config.abilities.feather_rain.ran: How far the rain can be aimed, in blocks.
ronova.config.abilities.crow_circle.dama: Damage of the attack in health points (2 = one heart, before armor); -1 — instant death, as by default. The strike around her.
ronova.config.abilities.crow_circle.radi: Radius of the strike, in blocks.
ronova.config.abilities.mortification.da: Damage of the attack in health points (2 = one heart, before armor); -1 — instant death, as by default. Mobs inside the sphere when it shatters, and players if «Players inside» is «kill».
ronova.config.abilities.mortification.pl: What happens to players inside when the sphere shatters: afterlife — they go to the Afterlife alive; kill — they take the sphere's damage (death by default); spare — they are let go.

ronova.config.abilities.beam.width.desc: Half-width of the killing zone around the full beam, in blocks (the quick beam is a little over half of it).
ronova.config.abilities.beam.blast_radiu: Radius of the explosion at the end of the full beam, in blocks.
ronova.config.abilities.orb.blast_radius: Radius of the orb explosion, in blocks.
When the rift opens, projectiles not shot by Ronova and End crystals within this radius burn to ash, in blocks. The opening itself kills no one.
Villagers this close run home and hide while the rift is open, like during a raid, in blocks. 0 — nobody hides.
While the rift is open, crimson clouds over it close in on a dark eye.
ronova.config.abilities.eye_spear.max_vo: Most feathers in one volley when there are many targets (at least 6; a locked target always gets 6).
ronova.config.abilities.feather_rain.spr: Radius of the circle the feathers fall into, in blocks.
ronova.config.abilities.feather_rain.rat: Feathers falling per second while held.
ronova.config.abilities.feather_rain.hit: Radius around each landing feather that hits, in blocks.
ronova.config.passive.auto_shield.thresh: Hits weaker than this are blocked by the passive shield; this strong or stronger break it and pass.
ronova.config.passive.auto_shield.cooldo: Seconds until a broken passive shield works again.
ronova.config.client.binds.desc: What the wheel key (X) + a hotbar key 1–8 does: use the skill in that place of the wheel right away, or only select it.
